# Code Generated by Sidekick is for learning and experimentation purposes only.
# filename: Test-CustomerFlow.ps1

# ============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================================
$API_GATEWAY     = "http://localhost:8080"
$AUTH_SERVICE    = "http://localhost:9000"
$FRAUD_SERVICE   = "http://localhost:8004"
$PUBLISHABLE_KEY = "pk_test_123"

$pass = 0
$fail = 0
$results = @()

function Write-Header { param([string]$t)
    Write-Host "`n$("="*70)" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "  $t" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "$("="*70)" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}

function Write-Step { param([string]$t)
    Write-Host "`n► $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

function Pass { param([string]$t)
    Write-Host "  ✓ $t" -ForegroundColor Green
    $script:pass++
    $script:results += [PSCustomObject]@{ Test=$t; Result="PASS" }
}

function Fail { param([string]$t, [string]$e="")
    Write-Host "  ✗ $t" -ForegroundColor Red
    if ($e) { Write-Host "    $e" -ForegroundColor DarkRed }
    $script:fail++
    $script:results += [PSCustomObject]@{ Test=$t; Result="FAIL: $e" }
}

function Info { param([string]$t)
    Write-Host "    $t" -ForegroundColor White
}

Clear-Host
Write-Host "`n╔$("═"*68)╗" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "║$(" "*20)CUSTOMER FLOW - COMPLETE TEST$(" "*19)║" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "╚$("═"*68)╝" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# ============================================================================
# TEST 1: HEALTH CHECKS
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 1: HEALTH CHECKS"

Write-Step "API Gateway health"
try {
    $h = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/health" -Method GET
    if ($h.status -eq "ok") { Pass "API Gateway healthy" }
    else { Fail "API Gateway unhealthy" }
} catch { Fail "API Gateway unreachable" $_; exit 1 }

Write-Step "Auth Service health"
try {
    $h = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$AUTH_SERVICE/health" -Method GET
    if ($h.status -eq "ok") { Pass "Auth Service healthy" }
    else { Fail "Auth Service unhealthy" }
} catch { Fail "Auth Service unreachable" $_; exit 1 }

Write-Step "Fraud Service health"
try {
    $h = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$FRAUD_SERVICE/health" -Method GET
    if ($h.status -eq "ok") { Pass "Fraud Service healthy" }
    else { Fail "Fraud Service unhealthy" }
} catch { Fail "Fraud Service unreachable" $_ }

# ============================================================================
# TEST 2: JWT TOKEN
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 2: AUTHENTICATION"

Write-Step "Get JWT token for customer"
try {
    $tokenResp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$AUTH_SERVICE/token" -Method POST `
        -Body (@{
            sub    = "cust_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')"
            email  = "customer@gmail.com"
            roles  = @("customer")
            scopes = @(
                "payment_session:create"
                "payment_session:read_own"
                "payment_method:tokenize"
                "payment_intent:confirm_own"
                "public_config:read"
            )
        } | ConvertTo-Json) -ContentType "application/json"

    $JWT = $tokenResp.access_token
    if ($JWT) {
        Pass "JWT token obtained"
        Info "Token: $($JWT.Substring(0,50))..."
    } else { Fail "JWT token empty"; exit 1 }
} catch { Fail "JWT failed" $_; exit 1 }

# ============================================================================
# TEST 3: PUBLIC CONFIG
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 3: PUBLIC CONFIGURATION"

$custHeaders = @{
    "Content-Type"      = "application/json"
    "X-Publishable-Key" = $PUBLISHABLE_KEY
    "Authorization"     = "Bearer $JWT"
}

Write-Step "Get public config"
try {
    $config = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/config" `
        -Method GET -Headers $custHeaders
    if ($config.merchant_id) {
        Pass "Config retrieved"
        Info "Merchant ID: $($config.merchant_id)"
        Info "Methods: $($config.supported_methods -join ', ')"
    } else { Fail "Config empty" }
} catch { Fail "Config failed" $_ }

# ============================================================================
# TEST 4: PAYMENT SESSION
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 4: PAYMENT SESSION"

Write-Step "Create session (capture=true)"
try {
    $session = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/payment_sessions" `
        -Method POST -Headers $custHeaders `
        -Body (@{
            cart_id     = "cart_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')"
            order_id    = "order_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')"
            amount      = 7500
            currency    = "usd"
            description = "Customer test order"
            metadata    = @{ test="customer_flow"; env="powershell" }
            capture     = $true
        } | ConvertTo-Json)

    $SESSION_ID = $session.session_id
    if ($SESSION_ID) {
        Pass "Session created"
        Info "Session ID: $SESSION_ID"
        Info "Amount: `$$($session.amount/100) $($session.currency.ToUpper())"
        Info "Status: $($session.status)"
        Info "Expires: $($session.expires_at)"
    } else { Fail "Session ID missing"; exit 1 }
} catch { Fail "Session creation failed" $_; exit 1 }

Write-Step "Retrieve session"
try {
    $s = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/payment_sessions/$SESSION_ID" `
        -Method GET -Headers $custHeaders
    if ($s.status -eq "created") {
        Pass "Session retrieved"
        Info "Status: $($s.status)"
    } else { Fail "Unexpected status: $($s.status)" }
} catch { Fail "Session retrieval failed" $_ }

Write-Step "Create session (capture=false - auth only)"
try {
    $authSession = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/payment_sessions" `
        -Method POST -Headers $custHeaders `
        -Body (@{
            cart_id  = "cart_auth_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')"
            amount   = 5000
            currency = "usd"
            capture  = $false
        } | ConvertTo-Json)
    if ($authSession.session_id) {
        Pass "Auth-only session created"
        Info "Capture: $($authSession.capture)"
    } else { Fail "Auth session failed" }
} catch { Fail "Auth session creation failed" $_ }

# ============================================================================
# TEST 5: TOKENIZE CARDS
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 5: CARD TOKENIZATION"

Write-Step "Tokenize Visa card"
try {
    $visaToken = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/payment_methods/tokenize" `
        -Method POST -Headers $custHeaders `
        -Body (@{ card_number="4242424242424242"; exp_month=12; exp_year=2026; cvc="123" } | ConvertTo-Json)
    if ($visaToken.payment_method_token) {
        Pass "Visa tokenized"
        Info "Token: $($visaToken.payment_method_token)"
        Info "Brand: $($visaToken.brand) | Last4: $($visaToken.last4)"
        Info "Expires: $($visaToken.expires_at)"
    } else { Fail "Visa token missing" }
} catch { Fail "Visa tokenization failed" $_ }

Write-Step "Tokenize Mastercard"
try {
    $mcToken = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/payment_methods/tokenize" `
        -Method POST -Headers $custHeaders `
        -Body (@{ card_number="5555555555554444"; exp_month=12; exp_year=2026; cvc="123" } | ConvertTo-Json)
    if ($mcToken.payment_method_token) {
        Pass "Mastercard tokenized"
        Info "Brand: $($mcToken.brand) | Last4: $($mcToken.last4)"
        $MC_TOKEN = $mcToken.payment_method_token
    } else { Fail "Mastercard token missing" }
} catch { Fail "Mastercard tokenization failed" $_ }

Write-Step "Tokenize Amex"
try {
    $amexToken = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/payment_methods/tokenize" `
        -Method POST -Headers $custHeaders `
        -Body (@{ card_number="378282246310005"; exp_month=12; exp_year=2026; cvc="1234" } | ConvertTo-Json)
    if ($amexToken.payment_method_token) {
        Pass "Amex tokenized"
        Info "Brand: $($amexToken.brand) | Last4: $($amexToken.last4)"
    } else { Fail "Amex token missing" }
} catch { Fail "Amex tokenization failed" $_ }

# ============================================================================
# TEST 6: CONFIRM PAYMENT (FULL FLOW)
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 6: CONFIRM PAYMENT"

Write-Step "Confirm payment with Mastercard (fresh fingerprint)"
try {
    $confirm = Invoke-RestMethod `
        -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/payment_intents/confirm" `
        -Method POST -Headers $custHeaders `
        -Body (@{
            session_id           = $SESSION_ID
            payment_method_token = $MC_TOKEN
        } | ConvertTo-Json)

    $PAYMENT_ID = $confirm.payment.payment_id
    if ($PAYMENT_ID) {
        Pass "Payment confirmed!"
        Info "Payment ID: $PAYMENT_ID"
        Info "Payment Status: $($confirm.payment.status)"
        Info "Amount: `$$($confirm.payment.amount/100)"
        Info "Card: $($confirm.payment.card_brand) **** $($confirm.payment.card_last4)"
        Info "Auth Code: $($confirm.payment.authorization_code)"
        Info "Session Status: $($confirm.session.status)"
    } else { Fail "Payment ID missing" }
} catch {
    $rawErr = $_.ErrorDetails.Message
    Fail "Payment confirmation failed" $rawErr
    try {
        $e = $rawErr | ConvertFrom-Json
        Info "Code: $($e.detail.code)"
        Info "Message: $($e.detail.message)"
        Info "Risk Score: $($e.detail.risk_score)"
    } catch {}
}

# ============================================================================
# TEST 7: ERROR HANDLING
# ============================================================================
Write-Header "TEST 7: ERROR HANDLING"

Write-Step "Invalid publishable key"
try {
    $badHeaders = @{
        "X-Publishable-Key" = "pk_invalid_12345"
        "Authorization"     = "Bearer $JWT"
    }
    Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/config" -Method GET -Headers $badHeaders
    Fail "Should have rejected invalid key"
} catch {
    if ($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__ -eq 401) { Pass "Invalid key rejected (401)" }
    else { Pass "Invalid key rejected ($($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__))" }
}

Write-Step "Missing publishable key"
try {
    Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/config" -Method GET `
        -Headers @{ "Authorization"="Bearer $JWT" }
    Fail "Should have rejected missing key"
} catch {
    Pass "Missing key rejected"
}

Write-Step "Invalid session ID on confirm"
try {
    Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/payment_intents/confirm" `
        -Method POST -Headers $custHeaders `
        -Body (@{ session_id="ps_invalid_999"; payment_method_token=$MC_TOKEN } | ConvertTo-Json)
    Fail "Should have rejected invalid session"
} catch { Pass "Invalid session rejected" }

Write-Step "Invalid payment method token"
try {
    # Create fresh session first
    $freshSess = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/payment_sessions" `
        -Method POST -Headers $custHeaders `
        -Body (@{ amount=1000; currency="usd"; capture=$true } | ConvertTo-Json)

    Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/payment_intents/confirm" `
        -Method POST -Headers $custHeaders `
        -Body (@{ session_id=$freshSess.session_id; payment_method_token="pm_invalid_token" } | ConvertTo-Json)
    Fail "Should have rejected invalid token"
} catch { Pass "Invalid token rejected" }

Write-Step "Expired JWT token"
try {
    $expiredHeaders = @{
        "Content-Type"      = "application/json"
        "X-Publishable-Key" = $PUBLISHABLE_KEY
        "Authorization"     = "Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ0ZXN0IiwiZXhwIjoxfQ.invalid"
    }
    Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$API_GATEWAY/v1/customer/config" -Method GET -Headers $expiredHeaders
    Fail "Should have rejected expired JWT"
} catch { Pass "Expired JWT rejected" }

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY
# ============================================================================
Write-Host "`n╔$("═"*68)╗" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "║$(" "*25)TEST RESULTS$(" "*31)║" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "╚$("═"*68)╝" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "`n  Total : $($pass + $fail)" -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "  Passed: $pass" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "  Failed: $fail" -ForegroundColor Red
if ($PAYMENT_ID) {
    Write-Host "`n  Payment ID : $PAYMENT_ID" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "  Session ID : $SESSION_ID" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}
if ($fail -eq 0) {
    Write-Host "`n  ✓ ALL CUSTOMER TESTS PASSED!" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "`n  ⚠ SOME TESTS FAILED - Review above" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}
